ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface area with approximately 5-10% localized high-intensity (white) pixel clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity pixel clusters are concentrated at the distal lobe tips. A singular, high-contrast circular blob is situated in the mid-section of the left lobe. A series of parallel high-intensity linear strokes are mapped to the outer region of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Shallow V-shaped depression with an approximate interior angle of 115 degrees relative to the lobe axes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the continuous trailing boundary; maximum peak-to-valley pixel amplitude is observed at the distal ends of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical upward sweep; leading edges exhibit moderate convexity; trailing edges exhibit a transition from central concavity to distal convexity.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized high-contrast circular pixel clusters (barnacle colonization) at the extreme tips of both lobes; isolated circular high-contrast spot on the left ventral surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of 6-8 distinct, parallel, vertically-oriented high-contrast linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) on the right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent parallel rake mark scarring on the right lobe; dense barnacle encrustation on both terminal lobe tips; singular circular scar on left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly specific vertical rake mark pattern on the right lobe provides a unique geometric signature.
